rating.comments: The first student message is the pasted task question and was ignored. The second message, "if there were 3500 students, how much water would be consumed", gives no reasoning of its own (reasoning 2). It extends the earlier weekly per-teenager figure to a new case of 3500 students, which is applying earlier information (knowledge building 3). It asks about a related case, so question asking is scored 1, though it is closer to a calculation request than a conceptual question. It is one complete, task-focused sentence with no follow-through, so effort is 3.
